**Download**

- `Tickfind.exe` (~0.5 MB) needs the [.NET 8 Desktop Runtime](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/8.0)
- `Tickfind-standalone.exe` (~70 MB) runs anywhere on Windows 10/11, with no runtime needed
- `Tickfind.apk`: the Android app ([how to install](https://github.com/BosTheCoder/tickfind/blob/main/docs/android.md)), added to the release after the build

Put the Windows exe in its own folder and run it, then sign in to TickTick. Press **Ctrl+Alt+F** from anywhere to search. To try it without TickTick, run `Tickfind.exe --demo`.

Already installed? Windows: ⚙ → Check for updates. Android: Settings → Check for updates.
